title: Unsupervised Detection of Contextualized Embedding Bias with Application to Ideology

bias_targets.methodology: Unsupervised detection of an ideological subspace in contextualized word embeddings (BERT) using a graph auto-encoder combined with orthogonality regularization and structured sparsity learning on a social network graph of Reddit subforums. The bias is evaluated through semantic probing using antonym pairs and indexical probing by clustering and predicting left-wing versus right-wing subreddit ideologies.
